newsitem.title: NAMIBIA: NAMIBIAN STOCKS WEEK - Barlow sees big trades.
newsitem.headline: NAMIBIAN STOCKS WEEK - Barlow sees big trades.

text.p: Heavy trade in newly-listed firm Barlow Ltd highlighted trade last week on the Namibian Stock Exchange as N$43.6 million worth of Barlow shares changed hands.
Other large trades included N$15 million worth of Engen stock and about N$9 million of Southern Life Association.

During the whole week to September 13 a total of 2,145,636 shares were traded with a total value of N$74.2 million. The NSE overall index ended the week at 234.16, up from the previous week's close of 227.82.
The NSE local index edged up to 154.03 from 152.22 pushed by gains in Namibian Sea Products and Ocean Diamond Mining, but held back by a fall in Gold Fields Namibia.
